1.explanation:
• dialog/index.md & index.en-us.md describe the Dialog props (including title) and layout so you understand the intended header behavior.  
• dialog/adaptor/index.jsx contains the rendering logic for header, title and close‐icon container, which likely needs adjustment when title is missing.  
• dialog/theme/index.jsx defines the CSS and positioning rules for the header and close icon.  
• dialog/demo/basic.md shows the standard Dialog with a title (baseline for comparison).  
• dialog/demo/should-update-position.md demonstrates positioning logic and may include code that updates offset—useful to reproduce or adjust the close button’s placement when no title is provided.
1.bug_scenario: When a Dialog is rendered without a title prop, its header area collapses and the close (×) icon remains positioned as if a title bar were present. As a result, the icon floats over and partially covers the dialog’s content text instead of sitting in its own header space.
